source: Mixtral’s paper explicitly notes that active-parameter analysis does not include memory cost and hardware utilization. ZXNAME0000XZ couples its expert architecture to node-limited routing and custom communication. Qwen3’s model card reports a much larger expert bank than Mixtral with eight active experts per token.
zh: Mixtral 的论文明确指出，主动参数分析不包括内存成本和硬件利用率。 ZXNAME0000XZ 将其专家架构与节点限制路由和自定义通信相结合。 Qwen3 的模型卡报告了比 Mixtral 大得多的专家库，每个代币有 8 位活跃专家。
